summary: Full backend + frontend regression for iter19 (per-device-type visibility toggles, admin god-mode, and refactored api_wq_config.py + Instruments/WaterQuality/User components). Backend pytest: 18 passed, 1 skipped (no wq_stp device in registry — expected). Frontend UI: all critical flows PASS — login works via username, ViewPermissionsDialog exposes 15 page + 8 device toggles (23 total), flowmeter toggle persists round-trip, cleanup succeeded, Instruments/WaterQuality/create-user wizard all render.

minor.issue: No wq_stp device seeded in registry — endpoint not exercised (test skipped). Confirm STP config path with a real wq_stp device in a follow-up.

critical_code_review_comments: api_wq_config.py PUT /{hw}/thresholds returns 400 'No fields to update' on empty payload — reasonable, but frontend must never send an empty thresholds payload; consider returning 200 no-op instead to be idempotent.
ViewPermissionsDialog: while loading, the vp-save button is already in the DOM (disabled) — E2E tests must gate on vp-enabled-count (post-load) to avoid interacting with a still-loading dialog.
admin_id / self-delete guard in api_admin.py uses 'Cannot delete self' (400) — matches spec. Admin-role-change guard returns 400 'Admin role cannot be changed'. All good.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled testclient.show_flowmeter_devices during tests and restored to True at end. VTFM001 / VTDO001 untouched. Admin left with role=admin, is_active=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend login POST /api/auth/login uses field 'email' (not 'identifier') and accepts email/username/user-id. Users list is at /api/admin/users/list (returns {users:[...]}). WQ thresholds endpoint requires at least one field from WQThresholdsConfig (turbidity_k / chlorine_min / chlorine_max / …) — empty {} rejects with 400. VP dialog only becomes interactive when [data-testid=vp-enabled-count] appears (not vp-save which pre-renders).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. Initial script authoring hiccups: (1) test used wrong login field name 'identifier' → 422, fixed to 'email'; (2) used /api/admin/users (404), fixed to /api/admin/users/list; (3) sent empty thresholds payload, fixed to send chlorine_min/max; (4) UI script queried vp-device-section before dialog data loaded — fixed by waiting for vp-enabled-count first.
